title: Liya Kedar: three words in the statement restyle the whole page
note: The one-screen home opens with a statement: 'Playing with TYPOGRAPHY, COLOR, and all kinds of TEXTURES is my thing.' The three words are underlined triggers. Hover one and the whole page re-renders in that mode, then snaps back when you leave. Typography swaps every line to a script, Color fills every cell flat, and Textures turns every photo into a line drawing. Built as one React state value (hover or locked) that every style reads from; the switch is instant, with no transition. On phones a tap locks a mode and a tap anywhere else clears it. The sentence that says what she cares about also demonstrates it. Worth reusing: let the intro's key words be switches that prove the claim, with a handful of modes that each change one visual system (type, colour, image) across the whole page.
